Results.ReviewText:
This grill replaced our 20 year old Weber 22" grill. Nice additions to this grill since our old one is the heat deflector on the lid handle and the temperature gauge.
The air vents in the base are redesigned and I have noticed a difference for the better there controlling air flow - more precise. 
The ash dump is the same except two hole punches that designate the position of the air vents ( open or closed).
The only bad thing I have found is that Weber only has one handle on the base of the grill now instead of two. Two handles also gave the option of having the lid either side depending on the wind. Have to turn the grill now.
You can't "wheel" it everywhere and picking it up with just one handle to carry it  does not work very well.

I'm just giving four stars because of the idea of just one handle on the base.

Results.Title: Great cooker!

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are the best charcoal grills out there, but like everything else these days, made lighter and cheaper. Not as heavy duty and well made like the one's I remember from the 1970's. Thinner metal and lighter gauge wire grills. Still an excellent grill for the money. As the old saying goes, "They don't make them like they used to" that just the way it is now with just about everything. I really like that the legs don't fall out when you lift the grill like the older models did. Great improvement.
Results.Title: Still a great grill. not the same quality of 1970'

Photos.Caption: All shiny and new. Ready for its first cook!
I was about to let a little snow get in the way of grilling!

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my 22” original kettle grill almost a year ago and started filling and smoking with it in the dead of winter! Yes, you read right I have and do smoke meat with my Weber grill. The construction is solid. It was a snap to assemble. The cooking real estate is immense. I can easily grill several hamburgers, hotdogs, and chicken breasts all at the same time and feed everyone. No one has to wait for what they want as other things are being grilled. Smoking is not an issue with the Weber either. Set up for an offset cook, add a couple lumps of smoke wood, mind your temp, sit back, and you will be rewarded with smoked meat that will melt in your mouth. I can’t say enough about my Weber grill and will be adding to my collection in the near future!
Results.Title: My go to grill!

Results.ReviewText: I got this for a Christmas gift. The instructions were on par and easy. Love the hooks on the handle. Only thing that sucks about grill is that the paint in two places chipped and there was a dent in the lid not worth sending back for it would be to much hassle.
Results.Title: My new Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Hi, I had a Webber’s grill for 20 year and finally the charcoal cleaner vents gave out from years and years of being used at lease once a week. I was going to just order the parts for it but my wife decided to buy me a new Webber’s grill for Christmas. I love the new grill it easy to use and I like the new vent system on the bottom a little better then my older one I have just have to get used to the adjustments a bit only used it twice since Christmas and that only a couple of weeks ago. But I still think I am going to get the parts for my old one and then I will have two great grills. Because my old grill is in such good shape I don’t have the heart to throw it away like my wife wants me to do lmao. Love the new grill but I love the old one too. Lol.
Results.Title: I love my new grill

Results.ReviewText: I needed a smoker on short notice after turkey plans for our company / employee Thanksgiving luncheon went sideways (Bojangles cancelled turkey sales).  Without much knowledge of smoking a turkey, I knew that the kettle grill was basically idiot proof & decided I could figure it out.  I picked up everything I needed at Lowe’s, including an iGrill thermometer that works with my iPhone.  After watching a couple short videos on the Weber app & phoning a pro smoker friend (who basically confirmed what the app said), we smoked two perfect turkeys in a little over two hours and had the best Thanksgiving lunch ever!  The thermometer / timer made it very easy & removed the guesswork.  There is an art to using the kettle  grill and managing the air flow & temperature,  but it’s simple enough to figure out with the Weber app & a couple YouTube videos.  We bought the chimney charcoal starter which works like magic, and a few other handling tools  from Lowe’s, but this was the easiest straight out of the box grilling event I ever attempted, and I won’t lie - I was a little worried before I started.  (We since cooked a beef tenderloin on it with excellent results as well.)  I’ve used other Weber kettle grills before & they are perhaps the best way to grill chicken, steaks, fish, or anything else that needs a little charcoal smoke flavor without a huge investment.  Love Weber charcoal smoke!
Results.Title: Easy Smoked Turkey

Results.ReviewText: My new copper 22 inch weber complements the rest of my collection of barbecues, this will make 9 grills for me. Because you know, the person  cannot have enough grills
Results.Title: Love my new Copper color 22’’ Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I have 3 Weber's now. Number 1 was given to me by my parents about 35 years ago. Everything is original except for the wheels and handles. And it still works great. Number 2 my kids have it to about 10 years ago. And it still works great. And now number 3 I got through my awards program at work. I always wanted one with the thermometer in the lid. And it is great. Can't wait until I am able to use all 3 of them at the same time.

Our good friend has one and he was very jealous of the slow cooking pork shoulder he was preparing one afternoon... so I caved and bought this. He has used it every single weekend (and a few week nights, too) since then and is now his new favorite past time. What's better than slow cooking and drinking beer the whole day?!

THEY OFFERED TO REPLACE THE WHOLE TOP DUE TO IF BEING BAKED ON. GREAT REPUTABLE COMPANY WITH EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE AND WARRANTEE!
Results.Title: EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE AND WARRANTEE!

Results.ReviewText: I replaced a 22” weber kettle grill that I had for 35 years 3 days before thanksgiving. I have been cooking my turkey on the grill for 35 years and the thought of having to cook it in the oven was  keeping me up at night! I kept thinking about how the turkey cooks so beautifully Brown and that lovely smoked gravy! I just needed to get a new grill! I went to Grates and Grills in Dublin Pa and got my new 22” premium grill. I got the indirect grilling baskets too. I am so pleased with the upgrade! The cooking grate hinges to add the More charcoal, brilliant! The baskets are so sturdy and really keep the charcoal on the sides allowing a drip pan to be placed between to catch the turkey drippings for that beautifully smoky gravy. I also love the charcoal collector in the bottom it so easy and clean. It has a thermometer in the cover but I did not find that useful for me. This is just the best grill you could buy. You will not be disappointed!
Results.Title: You cannot go wrong with a Weber grill!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been cooking on a Weber for 10 years, and you just can’t get a better grill. My only complaint - I didn’t get the 26”.

Results.ReviewText: I use this grill mostly to smoke chickens. I bought an 1/4 moon shaped  charcoal holder which also has a water reservoir. Light the charcoal, put some mesquite wood on top and set the chickens to the other side of the grill and about 2 hours later a great smoked chicken. I also use this when my family goes camping.

Results.ReviewText: Not sure how many Weber kettles I've purchased over the last 30 years, but I always bought the base model.. So glad I bought a premium.. like the ash catcher, hinged grill, heat guards, the legs now have push locks keeping the legs secure when I pick up and move it from time to time.  Snake method and baby backs 3-2-1..  Happy.
Results.Title: Simply the Best!

Results.ReviewText: I have owned many Weber charcoal grills throughout the years and have had excellent luck with their products and performance.. I recently purchased a 22" Copper deluxe grill with the hopes of the same performance.. I assembled the grill per instructions and using the lid screw tool.. It looked great! The first time I tried to used it the lid chipped where the holes were by the lid... I was crushed.. Weber sent out another lid, and it did the same thing... They sent out a third lid, but assembled the handle themselves... It was so loose that it flopped around every time I lifted it up... They obviously have a problem with this finish... I beat the heck out of my black grills and they all performed beautifully... Not one scratch or chip theur whole life... I just wish I could switch to the black version as I love the copper color but hate the quality control...
Results.Title: Poor quality control

Results.ReviewText: There is no better charcoal grill than a Weber! I love my new Kettle along with my other Weber’s.

Price is not that great in the country I living but in the U.S. has an awesome price. Highly recommended

I have done the normal burgers and chicken breast but have expanded to chicken thighs and smoked ribs. I have big hopes for continued smoking of new meats. The versatility of this kettle is pretty amazing. The different woods to infuse different flavors is a nice option.

The Weber grills are made with quality.
I expect to use my weber 22" for years to come.

I have recently purchased the charcoal racks to perform indirect grilling and get to smoking some ribs n brisket. I love the features the pit has and  they help to make cooking very easy. I would certainly recommend the 22” Weber Copper series.

Pizza stone on the grate makes the best pizza

Results.Title: Great system

Results.ReviewText: I have nothing but positive things to say about this grill. Overall great product. Fair price. No air leaks. Even cooking. Best grill on the market by far
Results.Title: Excellent product

Results.ReviewText: I bought this over the summer, and I’m so glad I did! It is so versatile and does great at both smoking and grilling. I loved it right out of the box, but have added a few accessories (which is another nice thing, there’s tons of things available to add if you want). My only regret is if I had to do it over again I’d buy the Master Touch since it comes with the charcoal baskets (which I’ve already purchased) and the upgraded grate (which I’ll prob get before next summer) which pretty much make up the cost difference and then there’s the additional height, lid holder, and upgraded wheels which I don’t miss but would be nice to have. Still though I’m so glad I bought a Weber kettle and the premium is fantastic!!!!!
Results.Title: Amazing Grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: I replaced an old one that had for 20 years. Great grill!
Results.Title: 20 year old replacement.

Results.ReviewText: We just bought the grill, used a couple of  times but we like it
Results.Title: charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Great product!  Highly recommend the rotisserie attachment to go with it.  Great customer service and warranty as well
Results.Title: Weber Kettle - Great

Results.ReviewText: This product is sure to satisfy anyone who loves grilled food. During my assembly of the grill, I marvelled at the simple yet thoughtful design. Food cooked perfectly and grill retained heat better than any other portable grill I've cooked on that cost less than $200. I think I've just bought my last charcoal grill!
Results.Title: Iconic product delivers satisfaction!

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber charcoal grill many many years ago and changed to a gas grill. I never like the gas grill. This fall i went back to the good old 22" Weber charcoal grill. It had quick shipment and easy assembly. I did not buy a cover at first. about 2 weeks after it was sitting outside. I noticed one little rust spot on one of the handles. I took pictures and sent them into Weber. I just wanted it documented so that in case it got worse, it was already on file. With no hesitation, Weber sent out a new bowl immediately. Great grill and great customer service. Highly recommend Weber.
Results.Title: Great grill and customer service.

Results.ReviewText: First charcoal grill that I have had in many years. It is fantastic, easy to clean, very well made. Use it just about everyday. Used an iron skillet to make eggs and bacon over charcoal and pecan wood chunks. Great ! Can't beat a Weber charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Outstanding features and great grilling !

Results.ReviewText: My old Weber (which is about 20 yrs old) had served its time and I felt it was time for an upgrade.  I am a die hard charcoal grill fan and Weber is the only grill to have.  It's a Weber.....what's not to love??  My old one was a smaller one (18 1/2") so I got a 22" in the copper color.  Gorgeous!  I've used it several times and was not disappointed.  I grill through the winter, so it will get plenty of use.
Results.Title: Love!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
